intentAndPurpose.intent: Sliding-conveyor pagination indicator for carousels and multi-page content. All N dots render inside a CSS-translating track; the active pill stays at the viewport centre when possible and walks toward the boundary near the start / end. Off-viewport dots collapse to 0 × 0 and scale up to edge (4px) as the conveyor slides them in, then back to 0 on exit — no pop-clip. Loop mode wraps last → first under --Motion-Duration-XL; every other advance runs at --Motion-Duration-L. CSS-only motion. Fully accessible: roving tabindex, keyboard nav, aria-selected.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages / items. Required.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role. `auto` resolves to `primary`. Default: `primary`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the tablist root.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name applied to the root.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Stable anchor for Playwright / QA harnesses (applied to the tablist / status root).

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop mode. `true` = stepping wraps (last → 0 and 0 → last), and the track reverse-slides its full length to get there. `false` = finite sequence, stepping stops at the ends. Default: `false`. The visible window clamps at the sequence edges in BOTH modes — loop does not keep the active dot centred by wrapping the window. That is a consequence of the translating-track conveyor: dots render in absolute order with `key = absIdx` so React never remounts them mid-slide, which is what lets CSS interpolate the width / height morph. A wrapped window would need the last dots rendered before the first, i.e. DOM reordering or ghost duplicates, either of which breaks that interpolation.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Fires when the active index changes (via click, keyboard, or controlled update).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: When true, disables all interaction (clicks, keyboard) and renders as a read-only live-region indicator (`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`). Use for components that purely mirror a parent carousel's state.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the root.

interactionBehavior.summary: PaginationDots are clickable tabs, not a mute indicator — each visible dot is a `<button role="tab">` that calls `setActive`. There is no hover or pressed recolour (`--_pg-bold-hover` is declared per appearance and never consumed; there is no `:hover` / `:active` rule). Keyboard arrows change the page, they do not merely move focus, then focus follows the new active pill. In conveyor mode (`pageCount` > 5, `[data-conveyor]`) a page change slides the whole `.track` horizontally — `transform: translateX(var(--_pg-offset))` transitioned over `--_pg-duration` (`--Motion-Duration-L`, bumped to `--Motion-Duration-XL` while `[data-wrapping]`) with `--Motion-Easing-Transition-Moderate` — so the dot cluster conveys sideways under the fixed viewport rather than the active pill hopping between static dots. Pass `readOnly` when the dots only mirror a parent Carousel: the root becomes `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"`, every button is `disabled` with `tabIndex={-1}`, and clicks / keys no-op. `Carousel.IndicatorList` does **not** pass `readOnly`.
press: A click on a dot (including an edge/small one) selects that absolute index — distant taps are allowed, not only neighbours.
There is no pressed fill or tap-scale; the acknowledgement is the active pill morphing to `--PaginationDots-activeWidth` in `--{Role}-Bold`.
`readOnly` sets `disabled` on every button and `setActive` returns immediately, so taps do nothing.
focus: Roving tabindex: only the active tab has `tabIndex={0}`; the others are `-1` and are reached by arrows, not Tab.
The halo is drawn on the visible `.dot` (circle or elongated pill), not on the tall `::before` hit area, so the ring hugs the shape instead of floating above it.
Two-layer halo: inner `--Stroke-XL` gap in `--Surface-Halo-Gap`, outer `--Focus-Outline` (spread `--Stroke-XL` + `--Focus-Outline-Width`).
Off-viewport conveyor dots are `aria-hidden` and never the tabbable one — the active dot is always in the viewport.
`readOnly` removes every tab from the tab order (`tabIndex={-1}`) and drops `role="tab"` so the status root is not a tablist.
keyboard: `ArrowRight` / `ArrowDown` step +1; `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowUp` step −1. Without `loop`, stepping clamps at the ends and does not move focus onto a stale neighbour.
`loop` wraps (last → 0, 0 → last). `Home` / `End` jump to first / last even in loop mode (they do not wrap).
After a key that actually changes the index, focus is moved onto the new active button so the halo follows the pill.
The handler is on the root and is omitted entirely when `readOnly`.
selected: The active dot is an elongated pill: width `--PaginationDots-activeWidth` (default `--Spacing-4`), fill `--PaginationDots-colorActive` → `--{Role}-Bold`, `aria-selected="true"` (or `aria-current="true"` when `readOnly`).

Inactive regular dots use `--Neutral-Stroke-Low` on a page-like surface (resolved step `2500` or `100`). Inside any other `[data-surface]` step they switch to `--{Role}-Stroke-Low` so they stay tinted with the appearance role.

In a conveyor (`pageCount` > 5) the outermost visible slots shrink to `--PaginationDots-edgeSize` (`--Spacing-1`) to hint that more pages exist; off-viewport dots collapse to 0×0 so they slide in and out of the conveyor instead of pop-clipping at the edge.
touch: Each tab's `::before` extends the hit area vertically by `--PaginationDots-hitArea` (`--Spacing-3`) only — not horizontally — so neighbouring 4px gaps never overlap and a fat-finger tap cannot skip a dot.

`cursor: pointer` is on the whole row (including the gaps) and `::before` inherits it, so the cursor does not flicker as you track along the cluster. `readOnly` / `:disabled` reset it to `default` and hide `::before`.
No hover fill means a tap cannot leave a stuck tint; the pill morph is the whole visual response.
